news.tx: James Hagens (Injured Reserve): Hagens (back) is wearing a non-contact sweater ahead of Tuesday's practice, Steve Conroy of the Boston Herald reports.
Dylan DeMelo (Injured Reserve): DeMelo (lower body) is expected to be out of action for 4-6 weeks, Mitchell Clinton of the Jets' official site reports Thursday.
Pavel Dorofeyev (Injured Reserve): Dorofeyev (lower body) will join the Rangers for their two-game road trip, Mollie Walker of the New York Post reports Tuesday.
Oliver Bjorkstrand (Injured Reserve): Bjorkstrand (upper body) is expected to be sidelined for 2-3 months, Peter Baugh of The Athletic reports Saturday.
Brandon Hagel (Injured Reserve): Hagel (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Lightning on Thursday, retroactive to Nov. 15, Eduardo A. Encina of the Tampa Bay Times...
Nikolaj Ehlers (Out): per the ESPN injury report, no further detail.
Kyle Palmieri (Injured Reserve): per the ESPN injury report, no further detail.
Connor McMichael (Injured Reserve): per the ESPN injury report, no further detail.
Jimmy Snuggerud (Day-To-Day): Snuggerud (undisclosed) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Islanders, per Lou Korac of NHL.com.
Evgeni Malkin (Day-To-Day): per the ESPN injury report, no further detail.
Bryan Rust (Injured Reserve): Rust (lower body) is skating in a non-contact sweater Friday, Seth Rorabaugh of Tribune-Review Sports reports.
Martin Pospisil (Out): Pospisil (upper body) didn't travel with his teammates for the start of Calgary's five-game road trip, per Eric Francis of Sportsnet on Monday.
Morgan Frost (Day-To-Day): Frost sustained an upper-body injury during Monday's 2-1 loss to the Senators, and head coach Ryan Huska did not have an update on the center's...
Jordan Kyrou (Out): per the ESPN injury report, no further detail.
Anthony Mantha (Injured Reserve): Mantha (neck) is expected to miss about one month after undergoing surgery, per Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News.
Quinn Hughes (Injured Reserve): per the ESPN injury report, no further detail.
Nick Schmaltz (Injured Reserve): per the ESPN injury report, no further detail.
John Marino (Injured Reserve): Marino (upper body) likely won't return during Utah's four-game road trip, per Brogan Houston of the Deseret News on Monday.
Nathan MacKinnon (Out): MacKinnon (lower body) has been evaluated by a specialist and is expected to miss the next 12 weeks, Aarif Deen of Colorado Hockey Now reports...
Cale Makar (Injured Reserve): Makar (lower body) was on the ice in a regular sweater ahead of Wednesday's clash with Montreal, Evan Rawal of the Denver Gazette reports.
Josh Anderson (Injured Reserve): Anderson (lower body) will be out for approximately 3-4 weeks, per Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports on Sunday.
Chris Kreider (Injured Reserve): per the ESPN injury report, no further detail.
Jared McCann (Injured Reserve): McCann (lower body) will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday.
Connor Bedard (Injured Reserve): Bedard underwent successful shoulder surgery Monday and is expected to make a full recovery in approximately four months, the Blackhawks announced.
Beckett Sennecke (Injured Reserve): Sennecke (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.
Leo Carlsson (Day-To-Day): per the ESPN injury report, no further detail.
Jacob Trouba (Out): per the ESPN injury report, no further detail.

Jack Roslovic (Day-To-Day): per the ESPN injury report, no further detail.
Erik Gustafsson (Injured Reserve): Gustafsson (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday, per the NHL media site.
Zach Hyman (Out): Hyman (migraine) won't play against Vegas on Tuesday, per Oilers play-by-play announcer Jack Michaels.
